name: Billy
source:
[i]"Hey baby, do you want me?"[/i]
[i]"C'mon baby.... Oh my little kitten. I'm very happy that I met you. You'll be safe with me, so how about we spend the night alone together. My arms are wide open, just for you."[/i]

A member of the A Team. Optimistic and easy-going.

Billy believes the pursuit of pleasure is the most important in life: he likes women, and often teases you. But he looks like a different person when he holds a gun: he is cool and reliable. When it comes to a gun, no one can compete with him. You would like him to be like that always.
